name: Temporary Emergency Shelter (Disaster / Rapid Deployment)
description: Compact, lightweight, prefabricated modular shelter designed for rapid field deployment in disaster response or temporary emergency relief. Optimized for minimal transport footprint and quick assembly.

name: Small Permanent Passive Shelter (High-Altitude Guard/Field Post)
description: Permanent passive solar outpost designed for high-altitude cold environments such as Ladakh pass checkpoints and observation posts. Features a south-facing Trombe wall and heavy earth/stone mass core.

name: Family Passive Solar Shelter (Rural Cold-Climate Residence)
description: Medium-sized multi-room passive solar shelter configured for rural families in cold desert and mountainous regions. Integrates direct solar gain, thick insulating walls on north/west/east facades, and attached sunspace buffer.

name: Field Research & Medical Station
description: Spacious modular field workstation and medical triage facility with partitioned functional zones, high thermal insulation, and provisions for solar thermal air collectors.
